family.description: This domain is present in aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases (aaRSs), enzymes that couple tRNAs to their cognate amino acids [[cite:PUB00066703]]. aaRSs from cyanobacteria containing the CAAD (for cyanobacterial aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases appended domain) protein domains are localised in the thylakoid membrane. The domain bears two putative transmembrane helices and is present in glutamyl-, isoleucyl-, leucyl-, and valyl-tRNA synthetases, the latter of which has probably recruited the domain more than once during evolution.
family.name: CAAD domains of cyanobacterial aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase
